definitions.explanation: A machine at train stations that calculates and collects the difference when a passenger's ticket doesn't cover the full fare to their destination.

examples.japanese: {精算機|せいさんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: Pay the fare at the fare adjustment machine.

examples.japanese: {精算機|せいさんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The fare adjustment machine is near the ticket gates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなかった→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{精算機|せいさんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: My ticket didn't cover the full fare, so I used the fare adjustment machine.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧ (settlement, fare adjustment) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine)

USAGE:
Found at train stations when passengers travel beyond their ticket's valid range. Insert the ticket, pay the difference, and receive an adjusted ticket or pass through.

WITH IC CARDS:
With IC cards like Suica or PASMO, {精算機|せいさんき} is used when the card balance is insufficient. You can add money (⟦チャージ→チャージ：09729_chaaji⟧) at these machines.

- ⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}し→乗り越し：23194_norikoshi⟧: riding beyond one's ticket
- ⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧: fare
